observations: Photo 0 shows a large blue plastic drum with a hinged lid held open by a hand, lid has a latch clasp and a small round vent/bung hole.
Lid rim shows a whitish/teal taped or sealant strip along the edge, suggesting a repair or reinforcement.

Background shows many similar blue plastic drums, kegs and jerrycans stacked together, at least one with an orange/red hazard diamond label visible, indicating a yard that stocks used/reclaimed chemical containers.
No capacity markings, brand embossing, or litre numbers are visible anywhere on the drum in the photo.
Ground is wet/muddy, drums appear used rather than new, with scuffed and dirty exteriors.

claims.claim: Implied suitability for general storage (by context of listing)

risks.proof: A photo showing the embossed litre capacity mark on the drum body or a tape-measure shot of height/diameter.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unverified-capacity used drum, not confirmed 220L

risks.proof: Close-up photo of this specific drum's body for any hazard labels, chemical residue, or odor description, plus seller confirmation of prior use.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the taped area and a photo of the lid fully closed to check fit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a compromised or repaired lid seal

risks.risk: General wear, scratches, or stress cracks in plastic not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including the base and exterior walls.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any embossed capacity marking on the drum body.
Photo of the drum fully closed showing the lid seal and latch engaged.
Photo clarifying whether this specific drum had any hazard labels or prior chemical use.
Wide shot or tape-measure photo to estimate actual dimensions.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used plastic storage drum, but capacity, prior contents, and lid seal integrity are all unverified from the single photo, so it must be priced at the worst-case condition (unconfirmed capacity, possible ex-chemical drum, repaired lid).
